scope: Version-dependent Python extraction, structured contracts, relationships, warning behavior, deterministic local HTML, and offline first view through both shipped development legs.

platforms.command: dev\windows.cmd python -m pytest tools\test_doxygen_gate.py tools\test_check_env.py tools\test_dev_environment.py -q
platforms.observed: 45 passed; environment checker executed doxygen, dot, git, node and pip at their exact pins

platforms.platform: Linux 6.18.33.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64, Docker Desktop linux-64 image
platforms.observed: fresh v5 Conda cache solve and image build succeeded; 45 passed in the non-root mounted checkout

behavior_matrix.claim: ordinary docstrings are parsed as Doxygen blocks under PYTHON_DOCSTRING=NO
behavior_matrix.expected: contract commands render as sections and a ghost parameter fails
behavior_matrix.observed: Parameters, Returns, Exceptions, Precondition, Postcondition and Invariant rendered; ghost parameter mutation exited non-zero

behavior_matrix.claim: leading ## and trailing ##< document representable values
behavior_matrix.expected: both descriptions appear on entity pages
behavior_matrix.observed: module, private, defaulted dataclass and enum values were members with their descriptions

behavior_matrix.claim: Doxygen's Python association boundary is explicit
behavior_matrix.expected: unrepresentable shapes are not credited to Doxygen
behavior_matrix.observed: local binding, nested function and annotation-only dataclass field were absent from XML member definitions

behavior_matrix.expected: text references plus call, caller and directory-dependency products
behavior_matrix.observed: References and Referenced by prose rendered; _cgraph.svg, _icgraph.svg and _dep.svg were generated

behavior_matrix.claim: generated HTML is deterministic and locally complete
behavior_matrix.expected: two equal trees and no remote runtime resource
behavior_matrix.observed: two HTML snapshots were byte-identical; no remote script/link/frame and no jsDelivr string remained under MERMAID_RENDER_MODE=CLI
genuine missing function failed; the Doxygen 1.10 documented-field false warning did not reproduce

behavior_matrix.claim: known residual defects remain assigned to more accurate checks
behavior_matrix.expected: the None-return and final-period-span reproducers remain red
behavior_matrix.observed: WARN_NO_PARAMDOC demanded a return for -> None; a code span ending in one period aborted its block

discovered_failures.failure: Git 2.51.2 and Graphviz 14.1.2 required incompatible PCRE2 ranges on linux-64
discovered_failures.resolution: Git was exact-pinned to 2.55.0, whose win-64 and linux-64 packages solve with PCRE2 10.47 and Graphviz 14.1.2

discovered_failures.failure: Docker cleanup deleted manifest-owned __pycache__ files from the mounted Conda package cache
discovered_failures.resolution: cleanup is bounded to /opt/conda/envs/claude and v5 starts from an independent package-cache namespace

graphviz_decision: retained: textual references alone do not generate the required call, caller and dependency diagrams; Graphviz generated all three and is exact-pinned and execution-checked
